parameters.query:
insert into socrates.alerts (
  alert_id, schema_version, ts_utc, ts_et,
  symbol, timeframe, setup_type, setup_name,
  grade, grade_points, direction, price,
  stop_price, stop_distance_points, stop_distance_dollars_per_contract,
  target_1, target_2, target_1_dollars_per_contract,
  level, volume, confluences, correlation_check,
  session, playbook_checklist, notes
) values (
  $1, $2, $3::timestamptz, $4::timestamptz,
  $5, $6, $7, $8,
  $9, $10::numeric, $11, $12::numeric,
  $13::numeric, $14::numeric, $15::numeric,
  $16::numeric, $17::numeric, $18::numeric,
  $19::jsonb, $20::jsonb, array(select jsonb_array_elements_text($21::jsonb)), $22::jsonb,
  $23::jsonb, $24::jsonb, $25
)
on conflict (alert_id) do nothing
returning alert_id, grade, ts_et, (xmax = 0) as is_new;

parameters.query:
select exists (
  select 1 from socrates.release_calendar
  where release_date    =  ($1::timestamptz at time zone 'America/New_York')::date
    and release_time_et between
        (($1::timestamptz at time zone 'America/New_York')::time - interval '15 minutes')
    and (($1::timestamptz at time zone 'America/New_York')::time + interval '15 minutes')
) as in_release_window;

update socrates.alerts
   set delivered_to_telegram = true,
       telegram_message_id   = $2::bigint
 where alert_id = $1
returning alert_id, telegram_message_id;

meta.description: Receives TradingView Pine webhooks for the Socrates Confluence Alert Engine. Validates, dedupes, persists every event to socrates.alerts, suppresses inside news windows, and posts A+/A/B grades to the Socrates Signals Telegram channel. C-grade is DB-only.
